description.value: Icy Bar is a Taiwanese-style dessert shop on the Kingsway corridor in Vancouver, specializing in shaved ice in a wide range of fruit and flavored combinations alongside drinks like milk tea and grass jelly. The menu also includes hot desserts, pancakes, honey toast, and snacks, making it a broad sweet-focused stop. Online ordering is available for quick pickup or delivery.
